title: Increase or decrease screen backlight by a percentage
summary: Adjust your screen brightness up or down by a specific amount relative to the current level. Useful for fine-tuning without knowing the exact target percentage.

steps.explain: Use the -A flag to add a percentage to the current brightness, or -U to subtract it. Replace <PERCENTAGE> with the amount to change.

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The amount to change brightness by (e.g., 10 or 20).

steps.expect: The screen brightness increases by the specified percentage.

alternatives.explain: Use the -U flag to subtract a percentage from the current brightness.

placeholders.name: PERCENTAGE
placeholders.description: The amount to change brightness by (e.g., 10 or 20).

alternatives.expect: The screen brightness decreases by the specified percentage.
